title: Let religion show up in conduct
summary: This meets the habit of praising religion in words while excusing behavior. The line pushes the question down into life.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today. Let conduct answer first.

source.shortMeaning: True religion appears in lived conduct, not in religious pose.
source.lifeApplication: Before praising religion again, ask what your conduct showed today.

evidence.coreClaim: True religion appears in lived conduct, not in religious pose.
evidence.turn: The truest religion is clean conduct sustained by Naam.
